item.title: Trump extends Lebanon ceasefire by 3 weeks
item.description:
US President Donald Trump has announced a three week extension of the ceasefire in Lebanon. In a post on Truth, Trump wrote: "The United States is going to work with Lebanon in order to help it protect itself from Hezbollah. The Ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon will be extended by THREE WEEKS. I look forward […]
